summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its consolidated results of operations for the second quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027, prepared under US GAAP. The earnings release reports 1H FY2026/27 net revenue of ¥1,294.2bn (+25% YoY), income before taxes of ¥359.5bn (+21%), net income of ¥249.3bn (+27%), EPS of ¥82.97 and ROE of 13.3%, with a half-year dividend of ¥35 per share. No transaction, ownership, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
